hook_structure: accusatory curiosity-gap hook: a blunt theft/loss claim ('captions are stealing your editing time') is slapped over a direct-address talking head with zero preamble, building word-by-word to force a read, then the pain is dramatized (tired eyes, every-hour grind) before the twist/payoff of naming the actual tool.

beats.read: The clip opens already mid-reveal, with the word 'captions' slammed over the speaker's face before any spoken setup — a hard, cut-in-media-res start.

beats.card_text: captions are stealing your editing time
beats.read: Text builds phrase-by-phrase over a static talking-head hold, letting the accusatory line finish forming before any cut, maximizing the claim's weight.

beats.cutaway_subject: close-up of hands typing on a mechanical keyboard on a green cutting mat, laptop and Coke crate in frame
beats.read: Cuts away to literal typing b-roll to visually back the claim that manual caption work is 'the part' being called out.
Punches back to the speaker rubbing his eye in visible fatigue, pairing the exhaustion gesture with the 'entire day' text for emotional proof.

beats.cutaway_subject: overhead wide shot of the creator sitting cross-legged in his chair with a laptop on his lap
beats.read: A quick lifestyle b-roll cut reinforces 'every hour' as an ongoing, repetitive burden rather than a one-time task.
Returns to direct address so the creator can state the problem himself, captions keyed word-by-word to his cadence for emphasis.

beats.cutaway_subject: low wide shot of the creator typing on a laptop at a standing desk under a round softbox light
beats.read: Cuts to a working shot to imply lived experience/credibility before the tool reveal, keeping the sentence trailing across the cut.

beats.cutaway_subject: motion-blurred whip/rack-focus profile shot of the creator turning toward camera
beats.read: A blurred whip-style transition signals a beat change, visually and sonically bridging into the tool reveal that follows immediately.
The tool's name lands as its own card on a clean talking-head cut — the payoff of the hook's curiosity gap, isolated for legibility.

beats.card_text: I was amazed / how much time / it actually saves
beats.read: A blank white card sequence pulls focus entirely onto typography, giving the reaction beat room to breathe before the demo starts.

beats.cutaway_subject: top-down screen recording of a desktop with a yellow arrow annotation pointing at an object on the desk
beats.read: Switches to screen-recording mode to begin the proof-of-concept walkthrough, arrow graphic added to direct attention.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of the Submagic web app: project folder, macOS file picker, upload modal, uploading progress bar
beats.card_text: you just / need to upload / the raw footage / hit AI captions / and pick a style
beats.read: A single continuous screen-record shot carries multiple caption changes, walking through the literal upload steps in real time rather than cutting per phrase.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of the caption style editor: font, size, stroke, color swatches, animation dropdown, spotlight/blur vignette added around active controls
beats.card_text: if you want it / for your client / just customize / the font, colors / size and animation / in seconds
beats.read: Extended single-shot UI demo with a moving spotlight vignette guides the eye to whichever control is being discussed as captions change underneath.
Breaks back to the speaker to reset attention and pivot the pitch from styling into automation features.

beats.cutaway_subject: screen recording of the Scenes panel: AI Auto B-rolls / AI Auto Zooms toggles, per-line transcript with A-roll/B-roll thumbnails, settings dropdown menu
beats.card_text: there's auto B-rolls / auto zooms / and it even / removes / bad takes / for you
beats.read: One long screen-recording shot lists automation features sequentially via caption changes instead of new cuts, keeping the feature list feeling continuous and effortless.

beats.card_text: this frees up / your time / to take on / more work
beats.read: Returns to the speaker to state the takeaway benefit directly, letting his delivery carry the payoff after the feature dump.

beats.cutaway_subject: over-the-shoulder shot of the creator's hand on a laptop trackpad with an editing timeline visible on screen
beats.read: Cuts to a lifestyle editing shot to visually anchor the 'editing for clients' payoff in a real workflow context.

beats.cutaway_subject: extreme close-up reflection on a curved monitor showing a video timeline, dark moody lighting
beats.card_text: or just / starting out CREATING CONTENT
beats.read: A moodier, blurred cutaway signals an audience pivot (from pro editors to beginners), with a distinct serif/italic card style marking the tonal shift.

beats.card_text: tap the link / in my profile / [you] / [Submagic]
beats.read: Closes on direct address for the CTA, with sub-captions in italics naming both the viewer and the product to make the ask concrete.

beats.cutaway_subject: TikTok app splash/loading screen with logo and a search bar reading '@ciggmedia'
beats.read: Ends on unedited platform chrome (TikTok's own loading/search screen) as a bare outro card pushing profile visits — no additional graphic treatment was added because the app UI itself does the CTA work.
